answer_markdown:
Across the fleet, 3 devices (7VP16KHV88LM, 8NM23J95R5I6, and M4XVHUV1MEPZ) transitioned to Service Recommended battery condition during the 30-day window and exceed the 800-cycle end-of-life threshold. The remaining 5 battery-equipped devices remain in Normal condition.

- Out of 8 battery-equipped devices inspected across the fleet [Q1], 3 laptops exhibit end-of-life degradation trends transitioning to Service Recommended status [E2, E5, E8].
- Device 7VP16KHV88LM (acme-macbook-1) started the window at 1017 cycles [E1], transitioned to Service Recommended on 2026-05-30 [E2], and reached 1049 cycles with Service Recommended status on 2026-06-12 [E3].
- Device 8NM23J95R5I6 (acme-thinkpad-8) started the window at 1127 cycles [E4], transitioned to Service Recommended on 2026-05-23 [E5], and reached 1157 cycles with Service Recommended status on 2026-06-12 [E6].
- Device M4XVHUV1MEPZ (acme-dell-9) started the window at 928 cycles [E7], transitioned to Service Recommended on 2026-05-24 [E8], and reached 948 cycles with Service Recommended status on 2026-06-12 [E9].

**Caveats & scope:**
- Telemetry as of 2026-06-12T11:00:00+00:00.
- Policy thresholds applied: battery_eol_cycles = 800 (global), battery_capacity_drop_pct = 3.0% (global).
- Excluded 1 non-laptop device and skipped 7 snapshots missing battery telemetry blocks from the 10 evaluated devices.
